hooks.description: Blocks merging/rebasing the base branch into a PR GitHub already reports as mergeable (restarts CI and review for nothing), blocks opening PRs as drafts, blocks `gh pr merge --admin` and `gh pr merge --auto`, merges without `--match-head-commit` and merges whose checks are not all green, blocks sleep-polling loops over gh status queries, and blocks posted comments that mention the Codex bot (override: `# codex-review-ok: <reason>`).
